ui.HOME_SUBTITLE: Choose a mode and face the challenge in the neon ruins.
ui.HOME_DESCRIPTION: Survive enemy waves solo, or battle friends together online.
ui.ROGUE_DESCRIPTION: Explore the neon ruins alone, survive escalating waves, and choose upgrades.
ui.ROGUE_TAGLINE: Choose a hero · Start the run · Survive the next wave
ui.LAN_DESCRIPTION: Join a room with friends on the same Wi-Fi and fight together.
ui.LAN_TAGLINE: Create a room · Invite friends · Fight together
ui.DUEL_DESCRIPTION: Challenge an AI opponent. First to four wins takes the match; choose an upgrade between rounds.
ui.SELECT_SUBTITLE_DUEL: Choose a fighter to enter the AI duel arena.
ui.SELECT_SUBTITLE_ROGUE: Review a fighter's abilities and enter the neon ruins.
ui.ROOM_CODE_NOTE: Share the room code with friends on your local network.
ui.LAN_HELP: Players on the same network can open this address in a browser.
ui.MAP_EVENT_CITY: Traffic surges across the streets. Impacts deal heavy damage and stun.
ui.MAP_EVENT_HOSPITAL: Fast anesthetists rush in; their first hit injects anesthetic.
ui.MAP_EVENT_MUSIC: Harps land at random and play for 5 seconds, damaging and slowing by 60%.
ui.MAP_EVENT_GYM: Musclebound bruisers charge out of buildings and deal massive damage.
ui.MAP_EVENT_AIRPORT: Aircraft use one of eight random runways; collisions hit hard and knock back.
ui.MAP_EVENT_SCHOOL: The office displays the class schedule. Classes last 10 seconds, slowing all units and reducing their attack speed and damage.
The office displays the class schedule. Classes last 10 seconds, slowing all units and reducing their attack speed and damage.
ui.MAP_EVENT_DUEL: One-on-one arena duel. Be the first to win four rounds.
ui.MAP_EVENT_MULTIPLAYER: Fight enemy waves with LAN allies; player attacks and effects are synchronized.
ui.PAUSED_HELP: Combat is paused. Resume when you're ready.
ui.ROUND_BREAK_HELP: Choose an upgrade. The next round starts in 10 seconds.
ui.PICK_UPGRADE_NEXT_WAVE: Choose an upgrade before the next wave.
ui.SKILL_EXP_HELP: Earn skill experience to strengthen your combat style.
ui.MP_INTRO: Join friends on the same Wi-Fi or local network in the neon ruins. The room server synchronizes player attacks, damage, health, and crowd control; PvE waves and upgrades are simulated by each client.

volt.name: Neon Champion
volt.tagline: Close in, knock them back, then land another punch.

volt-ult.name: Thunder Pursuit
volt-ult.description: Dash to the nearest enemy · Area stun

volt-chain.name: Concussive Fist
volt-chain.description: Empower your next basic attack · Knockback

volt-overdrive.name: Breakthrough Dash
volt-overdrive.description: Dash in your movement direction · Damage along the path

moss.name: Moss Guardian
moss.tagline: Turn the battlefield into your garden.

moss-ult.name: Briar Garden
moss-ult.description: Root the target area · Root enemies and restore health

moss-vine.name: Barkskin Bastion
moss-vine.description: Gain damage reduction · Melee attackers take thorn damage

moss-bark.name: Spore Bloom
moss-bark.description: Burst in the target area · Damage over time

luna.name: Lunar Eclipse
luna.tagline: Bring down the night sky from a safe distance.

luna-ult.name: Crescent Meteor
luna-ult.description: Choose a distant impact point · Large burst

luna-orbit.name: Crescent Wave
luna-orbit.description: Fire a moonblade at the nearest enemy · Pierce in a line

luna-phase.name: Moonshadow Shift
luna-phase.description: Blink in your movement direction · Gain 30 shield

tech.name: Tech Fighter
tech.tagline: Take control with tablets, afterimages, and chained dashes.

tech-ult.name: Overclock Assault
tech-ult.description: Stun enemies in basic attack range · Dash in your movement direction

tech-tablets.name: Five-Screen Convergence
tech-tablets.description: Launch five tablets · Converge and explode at 200 range

tech-afterimage.name: Afterimage Return
tech-afterimage.description: Leave an afterimage · Three invulnerable round-trip dashes that damage and knock back

pipa.name: Pipa Virtuoso
pipa.tagline: Spring snow, hidden troops, and a frenzied finale.

pipa-ult.name: Golden Serpent Dance
pipa-ult.description: Attack the 3 nearby enemies with the most remaining health and send them into a frenzy

pipa-yangchun.name: Spring Snow
pipa-yangchun.description: Hit and root the 3 nearest enemies for 3 seconds, restoring 20% of damage dealt as health

pipa-shimian.name: Ambush on All Sides
pipa-shimian.description: Summon 5 minions with 15 HP that autonomously pursue and attack enemies

armor.name: Nano Armor
armor.description: Take 8% less damage, up to 60% total reduction.

dodge.name: Phase Dodge
dodge.description: 8% chance to completely dodge an incoming hit.

vitality.name: Alloy Heart
vitality.description: Gain 25 max health and restore 25 health.

coolant.name: Coolant Injection
coolant.description: Immediately reduce current skill cooldowns by 2 seconds.

cooldown.name: Time Fold
cooldown.description: Reduce skill cooldowns by 8%, up to 40%.
